prompt-idle-walk.txt EXACT ISSUED PROMPT:
Create NEW reference-based hand-painted 2D game animation for ONE exact creature in the supplied original image: TWILIGHT NORMAL monster "시커" (Seeker). This is newly authored animation from existing project art, NOT recovered original frames.
IDENTITY MUST MATCH THIS EXACT SOURCE: a compact dark PURPLISH PLUM / reddish-violet mottled fleshy spherical floating body, ONE enormous orange-gold fiery FRONT eye with a black VERTICAL slit pupil and yellow iris center, a broad jagged-toothed FRONT mouth below that eye, short pointed bone/gold spikes around the sphere, about eight to nine thick curling ATTACHED eye stalks with small ORANGE eyes at their ends, and several thinner dangling attached lower tendrils. The big main eye is orange/gold, NOT a red glowing central eye. Preserve the original organic purple flesh, tiny orange eyes, spike pattern, compact orb/body-to-stalk proportions and detailed painterly dimensional shading. No ivory mantle, white flowing robe, magentaeye, human limbs, clothing, staff, weapons or added equipment. No legs or feet invented. The whole creature is ONE organically connected complete body; stalk-eyes remain connected by unbroken flesh stalks.
EIGHT direction columns LEFT TO RIGHT in exact order E, SE, S, SW, W, NW, N, NE. E is a true RIGHT-facing profile with main orange eye at leading right edge foreshortened to a narrow oval/crescent and mouth visible in side perspective; W is true LEFT-facing profile with corresponding actual left-side anatomy. Do not paste a fully round frontal eye or frontal mouth onto the side. S is direct FRONT toward viewer/screen-down and shows the original huge orange slit eye and jagged mouth. SE/SW are genuine front3/4 views. N is complete BACK away/screen-up and shows the bumpy purple REAR sphere, back spikes and connected back stalks with NO giant central front eye and NO front mouth visible through the body. NW/NE show real rear3/4 anatomy, not front faces with the eyes removed. Small orange stalk-eyes can face appropriate directions. All8 views independently rendered; no mirror shortcut or repeated still.
Fully TRANSPARENT RGBA background, NO shadows, ground, labels, text, grid, beams, aura, haze, detached particles, loose eyes, body fragments, cropped tips or empty frames. Whole creature including ALL stalks/spikes/tendrils must fit VERY SMALL inside each equal gridcell: aim45percent of cellwidth and50percent of cellheight, enormous completely transparent gutters on all sides, no neighboring figure bounds touching. Stable same body scale and anchor, retain all anatomical parts at every phase.
Every motion pose must have actual articulated changed stalk bends, eye aim, mantle/sphere flex and lower tendril curls. Simply scaling, translating, rotating or duplicating one still does NOT qualify. Keep original non-humanoid floating locomotion. No footstep animation or walking on human legs.
FIRST SHEET: EXACTLY8 equal COLUMNS by5 equal ROWS =40 complete independently articulated SMALL poses, landscape1536x1024 canvas. Direction columns fixed E SE S SW W NW N NE. FIVE rows top to bottom:
ROW1 IDLE A: relaxed floating sphere, stalks curling loosely at different heights, alert eyes, mouth in source resting expression.
ROW2 IDLE B: distinct breathing flex; upper two stalks curl tighter inward while side stalks uncurl slightly and lower tendrils bend the opposite way; body/eyelids flex organically without moving the same still.
ROW3 TRAVEL A: propulsion stroke toward facing direction; leading stalk cluster extends forward and trailing stalks curl under the sphere, lower attached tendrils sweep backward.
ROW4 TRAVEL B: passing/compression stroke; leading stalks retract into tighter C-curves while opposite cluster begins opening, lower tendrils fold underneath in a different silhouette.
ROW5 TRAVEL C: opposite cluster extends/uncurls and leading cluster returns; visibly different stalk angles, curls and overlaps from rows3 and4, making a genuine three-phase organic floating travel cycle. No vertical offset trick or repeated neutral stance.
Produce ALL40 complete figures, and all8 direction views in every row. Only idle and travel, no attack/hit/death in this sheet. Preserve the supplied source's distinctive purple flesh, giant orange verticalslit front eye, toothed mouth and small orange stalk eyes.
